items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now, what did you think of Fats Navarro? [INTERVIEWEE] Beautiful.

ctx.x: to make me like him. So -- he don't move me.
Now, what did you think of Fats Navarro?

Beautiful. That's what I'm talking about you understand what I mean?
Like, I'll go back to Duke, like before, I says there are too many notes in here and he says yes, well, I can't play them, he says be sure that you pick the right ones and he was bugging him about those notes.
That meant, that if you don't make that right note, I'm going to run you out of here. Boy played the -- as beautiful as he could play it and play all the notes -/ he was a lyrical man. See? Louis Armstrong was a lyrical man.
Dizzy is a man…
